title: dioscorea bulbifera var. elongata
intro: Dioscorea bulbifera var. elongata, commonly known as the elongated yam, is a variant of the yam plant that belongs to the Dioscoreaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, contributing to its use in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dioscorea bulbifera var. elongata include immune system enhancement, cardiovascular support, and potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal effects include diosgenin, a steroid saponin, as well as other compounds like alkaloids and phenolic acids.
